name: Lady Agent Gina ~Onna Spy Shichihenge
original_name: レディ・エージェント・ジーナ～女スパイ七変化
source:
A beautiful woman spy, Gina Lovelace.
A fiery agent combining outstanding brains and outstanding body style.

The task given to her this time is to infiltrate the country ∪ to capture the golden manufacturing equipment gold breeder invented by Dr. Golden Goldsky.

Gina takes full advantage of her beautiful face and body and carries out her duties.
Her skill is a splendid disguising technique that can get in anywhere.

美丽的女间谍吉娜·洛夫莱斯。
她是兼具卓越头脑与完美身材的热血特工。

这次交给她的任务，是潜入∪国，夺取黄金制造设备——由黄金博士·戈尔登·戈尔德斯基发明的黄金繁育器。

吉娜充分利用美貌与身材执行任务。
